data_check_interpretation.facts: 2,132,218 crash rows have crash_date in 2013–2025; 136,969 rows with dates outside that period are excluded; 0 rows have a missing crash_date; within-period crash_date has 0 impossible DATE values and 0 conventional default dates. data_check_interpretation.decisions: Keep every row with a date in 2013–2025. Exclude dated rows outside the requested years. No rows are excluded for missing, impossible, or conventional default dates. Reported boundary coverage does not prove complete reporting within each year.

final_plan.can_answer: yes, for each weekday's share of police-reported crashes recorded with crash_date in 2013–2025
final_plan.metric: Percentage of all in-period crash rows attributed to each weekday of crash_date
final_plan.denominator: All included crash rows with crash_date in 2013–2025 (2,132,218 rows)
final_plan.population: One row per police-reported NYC motor vehicle crash with non-NULL crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025
final_plan.years: 2013–2025 inclusive; each year has observed dates from January 1 through December 31, though boundary observations cannot establish completeness of reporting
final_plan.grouping: Weekday of crash_date, Monday through Sunday
final_plan.limitations: Shares are of recorded crash rows, not people, traffic exposure, or risk. The plan excludes 136,969 rows with crash dates outside 2013–2025; none of the rows has a missing date, and none of the included dates is impossible or a conventional default. Annual row counts rise from 203,742 in 2013 to a peak of 231,564 in 2018, then decline to 85,546 in 2025, so the pooled share weights years according to their number of recorded crash rows.
